summary: Reads camera transform, plane tracking, and optional body-tracking channels from a ZED camera/ZED TOP workflow.
key_concepts: ZED CHOP is a Windows-only operator for reading positional, plane, and optional body tracking from Stereolabs ZED hardware.
The operator depends on a primary ZED TOP camera source and the ZED SDK workflow documented by Derivative.
Camera Transform outputs camera translation and rotation channels such as `camera:tx` and `camera:rx`.
Plane detection can use a U/V sample point and return plane position, rotation, normal, and size in world or camera reference frames.
Body Tracking can output 3D joints, 2D UVs, body IDs, tracked/moving state, velocities, and bounding boxes for multiple bodies.
Tracked-body channels are prefixed by person index, such as `p1` or `p3`, so downstream channel matching must account for dynamic body counts.

key_params.name: cameratransform
key_params.note: Output camera tx/ty/tz and rx/ry/rz channels

key_params.name: planeorientation
key_params.note: Plane coordinates relative to world or camera

key_params.name: planereferenceframe
key_params.note: Return plane data in world or camera reference frame

common_gotchas: Official docs list this operator as Windows-only.
ZED CHOP depends on a ZED camera/ZED TOP source for tracking data.
Camera transform outputs camera:tx/ty/tz and camera:rx/ry/rz when enabled.
Body-tracking channels are prefixed by person index such as p1 or p3 and by joint name.
Max Bodies and joint mode strongly affect channel count and downstream naming.
Plane detection can report orientation relative to camera or room/world; choose deliberately for AR alignment.
